> Standardizes a localhost DDP systems exercise for communication overhead studies, not a public recommendation-model score.

## At a Glance

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Suite** | distributed |
| **Model** | micro-dlrm-1m via torch.distributed (Gloo, 2 ranks, localhost) |
| **Parameters** | 1.0M |
| **Scenario** | training |
| **Maturity** | base |
| **Public status** | systems-only |
| **Provenance** | Iter-10 (Dean): two-process DDP smoke. Demonstrates DDP-vs- gradient-accumulation loss equivalence (delta 0.0064 < 0.02 check). AllReduce overhead 0.6 ms/step on M5 Max loopback Gloo. |

## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
mlperf fetch --workload micro-dlrm-distributed --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
mlperf run --workload micro-dlrm-distributed --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
mlperf run --workload micro-dlrm-distributed --profile min

# research envelope
mlperf run --workload micro-dlrm-distributed --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.
